Attributes and skills

The formulas below describe this engine's current rules. Item and spell examples are calculated from your loaded game data.

Which skill unlocks a spell?

Spell knowledge uses its magic-school skill, Intelligence minus 25, and the relevant perk bonus. Extra knowledge unlocks more complex spells; rune construction determines spell power. The planner compares your base knowledge and stamina with each planned spell.

Build planner

Hero Attack combines the weapon rating, the corresponding combat skill and Dexterity − 25, then applies relevant perks. Melee Defense uses the melee skill and defensive weapon rating; bows and crossbows give zero weapon Defense.

Health and stamina pools use earned experience, attributes and the game's configured growth curves. Maximum equipment load starts at Strength × 12. Action speed starts at Dexterity × 0.2 + 10; perks and effects can change these values.
